intensity_columns_used: LFQ intensity H1..H4, LFQ intensity L1..L4
filtering_rule: removed Reverse, Contaminant and Only-identified-by-site rows; then complete-case filter requiring positive LFQ intensity in all 8 samples
normalization_method: median normalization: per-sample median of log2 intensities centered to the overall median
test_method: Welch two-sample t-test on per-protein sample means of log2 LFQ intensity, H minus L; Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment
processing_order: flag removal -> complete-case filter -> log2 -> median normalization -> Welch t-test -> BH correction
